stage_entry_gates.cohort_safety: observed moderation-report rate is at or below the experiment safety_stop_report_rate with a nonzero denominator
stage_entry_gates.retention: day-7 retained-member rate does not regress by more than 2 absolute percentage points versus control
stage_entry_gates.fraud: at least 100 resolved review cases or all cases in the window, whichever is smaller; false-positive rate at or below 10 percent; no unresolved critical case beyond SLA
stage_entry_gates.xp_economy: mean earned XP per exposed member is no more than 5 percent above the approved variant projection after cohort mix adjustment
stage_entry_gates.projection: completion p95 at or below 2 seconds, oldest pending age at or below 30 seconds, zero dead letters
stage_entry_gates.decision_record: named safety-stop owner, evidence URI, decision note, approving operator and immutable stage history

stop_policy.action: set experiment status to paused; assignments remain for analysis while runtime multipliers stop applying
stop_policy.resume: repeat the current-stage gate with fresh evidence and a new immutable decision record

fraud_tuning.account_action: attributed operator decision through progression controls

production_acceptance.rationale: Local stage enforcement, review-only fraud tuning, projection load automation and monitoring assets are complete. Production remains blocked until real exposed cohorts, target-environment load, paging and safety-stop drills provide evidence.
